subject: Community credits and maintainers trial runbook — HackUp summer series
messages:
From: Nadia Rahman <nadia@hackup.org>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: OpenScribe Maintainers <maintainers@openscribe.dev>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: maintainers content credits + short trial extension for HackUp summer series

Hi Soojin + Marissa —

Thanks again for chatting at OpenInfra last month. HackUp is running a three-week online developer series (Aug 12–Aug 30) focused on contributor tools; OpenScribe is one of our featured communities and many maintainers run live code labs. We had a last-minute ask from several maintainers who need additional compute/credits so they can run interactive demos and host small model-based examples for attendees.

Two asks: 
- A one-time pool of content credits (approx. 150k tokens worth) earmarked for OpenScribe maintainers to split across ~6 demo projects.
- A short trial extension so project teams can keep test projects active through Sep 30 (current trial ends Jul 15).

We can provide a short blurb for the announcement and include Redwood in event materials. If you prefer to limit by project or provide promo codes per maintainer, we can take that approach.

Event details: HackUp Summer Series, expected live attendees ~1.2k, maintainers participating: 6, demo slots: 12.

Happy to hop on a 20-min call if helpful — we’re trying to finalize logistics this week.

Thanks,
Nadia Rahman
Program Manager, HackUp Org
[HackUp Org — ops@hackup.org]

[Attachment: HackUp_SummerSeries_onepager.pdf (PDF)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Nadia Rahman <nadia@hackup.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 17:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: maintainers content credits + short trial extension for HackUp summer series

Hi Nadia —

Really excited about this — congrats on pulling together the lineup. We can likely support both asks but need to confirm sizes and internal approvals. Quick questions to help scope:
1) Are the demos smoke tests (short inference bursts) or longer-running interactive notebooks?
2) Do maintainers need dedicated model variants (quantized / local private) or is hosted tokens sufficient?
3) Are you ok with us providing per-maintainer promo codes, or would you prefer a single pooled voucher?

I’m looping in Marissa and Karthik to confirm credit pool size and whether we need to route through partner ops or a sales SKU for sponsor credits. I’ll also attach our community credit runbook and a draft email template to speed turnaround.

Thanks — can do a 20-min slot Fri if that helps.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Community Partnerships
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: community-credit-guidelines.pdf (PDF)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 09:32:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: maintainers content credits + short trial extension for HackUp summer series

On Thu, Jul 1, 2027 at 09:05 AM Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Nadia —
>
> Really excited about this — congrats on pulling together the lineup. We can likely support both asks but need to confirm sizes and internal approvals.

Thanks — putting a recommendation forward. Proposal:
- Provide a pooled promo of 150k token-equivalent credits (split across 6 maintainers; we can issue 6 codes of 25k each).
- Extend trial for participating project teams to 2027-09-30.
- Limit per-project sustained concurrency (soft limit) to prevent accidental long-running jobs — suggest 4 concurrent connections / project.

I attached a draft email template you can share with maintainers and a short checklist for ops to verify projects meet the program rules.

Approval path: partner ops sign-off (Karthik) + marketing blurb clearance (Vanessa, cc’d). If legal asks for any contractual language we’ll route through sales.

Marissa Cole
Head of Community Programs
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: draft-credit-email-template.txt]

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: maintainers content credits + short trial extension for HackUp summer series

Marissa / Soojin —

Sounds reasonable. A couple operational notes from partner ops:
- Use partner SKU PART-CRED-2027 for promo issuance so finance can track spend to the partnership bucket (DEAL-9081).
- For the trial extension we should issue time-bound voucher codes that automatically expire on 2027-09-30.
- If the maintainers request specific model variants, we should only allow hosted/open models under the promo (no private dedicated deployment without a commercial agreement).

I can issue the codes once Marketing confirms the announcement copy. Also recommend limiting the pool to 180k token-equivalent as a safety buffer in case demos run long; we can re-evaluate usage mid-September.

— Karthik
Partner Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Nadia Rahman <nadia@hackup.org>

Subject: Re: Request: maintainers content credits + short trial extension for HackUp summer series

Hi Nadia —

Great news: we have internal buy-in to support HackUp’s maintainers. Final plan below — we’ll issue the vouchers once you confirm the list of maintainers and the preferred distribution method.

What we’ll provide:
- 6 voucher codes, each 30k token-equivalent (total pool 180k) — codes auto-expire 2027-09-30.
- Trial extension scoped to projects tied to the event; maintainers should register projects via the form in the drive link below so we can map codes.
- Soft concurrency limit: 4 active sessions per project; ops will monitor and reach out if a demo runs long.

Next steps for you:
1) Share a short list (name + email + repo name) for the 6 maintainers by Mon 07/05.
2) Confirm whether you want individual codes or one pooled code.
3) Approve the short blurb in the draft email (I’ve attached Marissa’s template).

Logistics links: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcdExampleRunbook
HubSpot reference: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/openscribe (for our tracking)

If that all looks good I’ll ask Karthik to generate the PART-CRED-2027 codes and we’ll share the codes + short how-to for maintainers.

Thanks again — excited to see the demos.

Best,
Soojin Lee

Redwood Inference
